root_schema: root.seed (signed int64), root.candidates (canonical legal-action indices); all other fields are metadata, never restore state
selection: First reachable boundary per seed and stage, including exploratory branches before choosing a turn. No filtering on continuation difficulty. Uniform sampling over families within eligible partition/stage. Stages with fewer than 20 families are diagnostic-only. No stage is released until original validation passes.
search_bias: Weighted card/reward/map policy and true-future search favor survival, HP, poison/scaling, and keys. Initial pilot/breadth/breadth3 retained one turn candidate; later searches retained up to two distinct-score turn candidates through a combat. Floor checkpoints retry failures. First Act2 roots were extended; the three Act3 families received 60000 decisions each. Act1 boss collection was added after scarce late-stage coverage. No search result is a training label.
difficulty: 16 uniform legal continuations capped at 2048 decisions each; 4 search RNG streams, 512 engine decisions each, up to two turn candidates and four sampled continuations per candidate. Search success is finding the target within this budget; returned deaths and live cutoffs are reported separately. The search returns its best finished branch when any finished branch exists, even if live branches remain at budget exhaustion. A zero search rate does not establish that a root is unwinnable. All trials keep the same game RNG world; only policy RNG varies. No difficulty filtering.

entries.name: oracle-extra-interrupted
entries.cpu_measurement: upper bound: ten logical cores times JVM log elapsed; parent exited before recording rusage

budget.cpu_scope: Collector processes, Python collection wrappers, prefix/batch replay, strict replay and original/idle JVMs; excludes compilation and interactive inspection. The interrupted original JVM uses a conservative ten-core-times-wall bound because its parent exited before saving rusage.
budget.stop_reason: Original parity failures block acceptance; leave remaining decisions unused. Family targets are met only after moving coverage to Act1 boss and Act2 entry.

results.stopped: original rejects choose option 4 at floor 44 before root; partial trace has no terminal

validation_summary.build: Release native collector and spire module compiled; device/LLVM/layout build checks passed

blockers.difference: Terminal actions length: original 3, engine 2. Original retains a VFXAction between Dagger Spray hits; engine queues only the damage actions.
Terminal actions length: original 5, engine 3. Original Snake Plant attack retains two VFXActions that are absent from the engine queue.

After cancelling a GRID at floor 44, original returns to COMBAT_REWARD with three potions; engine returns to SHOP. Original rejects later choose option 4. Root is not original-reachable by the stored prefix.

gaps: No collection release: two strict terminal mismatches and one original-illegal prefix remain; no core, host, snapshot, trace or comparator changes were made.
Act3 entry covers only two train families and one dev family. Heart covers one train family and zero dev families. Sparse stages violate the 5% family bound and are diagnostic-only.
No root has an empirical uniform-policy success fraction in the 10%-80% range from its 16 continuations; these are difficult candidate states, not demonstrated learnable curriculum roots.
Original audits cover 34 selected roots, not every collected family. Difficulty measurements use the engine and do not establish original-game continuation rates.

discovery.source: Fresh Neow resets in declared train/dev ranges; later discovery replays existing prefixes and searches engine copies.

storage.scope: E2-created files only. /private/tmp already contained about 14 GiB from other work at task start; those files were not removed.
